SELECT AnzsicClassCode, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode, COUNT(*)
FROM BNKM.AnzsicClass
GROUP BY AnzsicClassCode, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

SELECT BranchID, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode, COUNT(*) 
FROM BNKM.Branch
GROUP BY BranchID, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1


SELECT BranchGroupId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode, COUNT(*) 
FROM BNKM.BranchGroup
GROUP BY BranchGroupId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1


SELECT BranchId, FinancialInstitutionId, BranchRelatedRegionTypeId, SourceSystemCode, COUNT(*) 
FROM BNKM.BranchGroupBranch
GROUP BY BranchId, FinancialInstitutionId, BranchRelatedRegionTypeId, SourceSystemCode
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

SELECT Id, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode, COUNT(*) 
FROM BNKM.BusinessOnlineBankingAccount
GROUP BY Id, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode

SELECT CityId, FinancialInstitutionId, COUNT(*) t
FROM BNKM.City
GROUP BY CityId, FinancialInstitutionId

SELECT ConsentId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceCode, COUNT(*) FROM BNKM.Consent

SELECT CustomerAccountId, AccountNumber, SourceSystemCode, COUNT(*)

SELECT CreditRiskId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode, COUNT(*)

SELECT ConvertFromCurrencyId, ConvertToCurrencyId, CurrencyConversionTimestamp, RateId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceCode, COUNT(*)

SELECT CustomerId, SourceSystemCode, COUNT(*)
